subject.title: feat(matrix): add configurable read receipt timing

question: Should OpenClaw expose the full Matrix `immediate`/`on-reply`/`off` policy with per-account overrides, or should this land as a narrower channel-level opt-in first?
rationale: The implementation is a new user-visible configuration and policy contract rather than a repair to an established API; the contributor has explicitly deferred the permanent surface choice to maintainers.

options.title: Approve the full scoped policy
options.body: Keep the three modes and per-account overrides after restoring compatibility for pre-existing non-object account entries.

options.title: Land a narrower channel-level policy
options.body: Limit the initial public contract to the smallest channel-level opt-in that solves delayed acknowledgement requirements, deferring account overrides or disabled receipts.

recommendation.title: Approve the full scoped policy
recommendation.body: Keep the three modes and per-account overrides after restoring compatibility for pre-existing non-object account entries.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposer owns the current contract proposal and has offered to implement the maintainer-selected scope.
